prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Katy, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1472; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, if that's okay. You already have it on the claim.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was in the parking lot of a shopping center in Katy, Texas. I was backing out of a space near the main entrance.

Q: What happened next?

A: A pickup truck was coming down the aisle, and I didn't see it until my back bumper was already in its path. We hit on the rear quarter panel of my car and the front corner of the truck.

Q: Were you going fast?

A: No, I was barely moving. Maybe walking speed. It was a low-speed impact, but I felt the jolt in my head pretty hard.

Q: Did you hit your head on anything?

A: I think my head snapped forward and then back against the headrest. I didn't lose consciousness, but I had a headache right away and I felt foggy for the rest of the afternoon.

Q: Have you seen a doctor since the accident?

A: Yes. I was seen at urgent care, and they diagnosed a concussion. I've been told to limit screen time and rest as much as I can. Some days the light bothers my eyes and I get dizzy when I stand up quickly.

Q: Are you still having those symptoms?

A: Yes, they come and go. I'm waiting to hear back from a neurologist for a follow-up appointment.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I'm trying to be patient with the process. I just want to recover and get back to normal.
